status: Approved daily-scope policy; retained candidates are not blanket quality-certified
source: Library curation records and current local native skill settings
discovery_limit: Remote plugin exposure varies. 28 plugin disables are config-verified, live discovery pending. Counts reconcile the last complete snapshot with current settings, not a fresh complete discovery.
portable_rule: Paths use ${HOME} placeholders. Do not blindly replay on another machine; reconcile installed versions and project ownership first.
default_install_rule: Do not bulk-install the archive as the daily global collection. Use the retained standalone list and curated plugins; specialists are opt-in per project.
